Heraliz Emote bundles two mods by KosmX, unmodified, so that players only need this one jar
(Forge "jar-in-jar": they are loaded as their own mods, from META-INF/jarjar/):

- Emotecraft 2.2.7-b.build.50 for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)
  Copyright (c) KosmX - https://github.com/KosmX/emotes - https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft
  Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0):
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ - full text in third_party/emotecraft/LICENSE.txt
  The bundled jar is the original file published on Modrinth, not modified.

- Player Animator 1.0.2-rc1+1.20 (Forge)
  Copyright (c) 2022 KosmX - https://github.com/KosmX/minecraftPlayerAnimator - https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator
  Licensed under the MIT license - full text in third_party/playeranimator/LICENSE.txt
  The bundled jar is the original file published on Modrinth, not modified.

When a newer Emotecraft or Player Animator is in the mods folder, Forge uses that one instead.
